question: How much will be 59°F in Celsius?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15ºC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The conversion formula from Fahrenheit to Celsius is:
 
• C = 5/9 (F - 32) = 5/9 (59 - 32) = 5/9 × 27 = 15°c
 
• This temperature conversion is essential for scientific calculations and day-to-day temperature understanding.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Fahrenheit scale is primarily used in the United States, while the Celsius scale is used in most other countries.
 
• The freezing point of water is 0ºC or 32ºF, and the boiling point of water is 100ºC or 212ºF under standard atmospheric conditions.
 
• Understanding how to convert temperatures between these scales is useful for international communication and travel.
